title: Bubble in Non Stick Coating!
text: Bubble in Non Stick Coating!. Very poor quality!.....Had a bubble in the coating right out of the package!

product_metadata.title: Avanti Ever-Glide Non-stick Muffin and Cupcake Pan, 12-Cup
features: Durable muffin and cupcake pan for every day use
Made of steel; reinforced non-stick coating for easy release and quick cleanup
Pan dimensions: 10.5 x 13.5 x 1 in. (27 x 34 x 2.5 cm); Cavity size: 2 in. dia. x 1.25 in. (5 cm diam x 3 cm)
Dishwasher safe; however for best results, wash in warm, soapy water before first and after each use
description: If you love to bake cupcakes and muffins, you need a non-stick muffin pan that holds up day after day. The Avanti Ever-Glide Non-Stick Muffin Pan is a baker's best friend. The commercial weight construction distributes heat evenly and prevents the pan from warping, while the oversize handles make it easy to put in and take out of the oven. The reinforced non-stick coating resists scratching, making it safe to use with most metal tools.
